messages.content: You translate German letters of the 1820s into plain modern English. Keep every fact, name, place, time and number. Add nothing, explain nothing, leave out nothing. Answer with the translation only.

Vienna, 21st Sept.

My dearest Marie,

I have reached Vienna safely, after a long, dusty journey of forty-two miles from Prague. We travelled in an express coach with a couple returning from Karlsbad and the Archduke’s physician. The hours were long, but the company kept the time passing.

I took a room at the Erzherzog Karl and spent the evening at the Italian opera. It was a Mercadante piece, with Rubini, Donzelli, Lablache, and Eckerlin singing. I must confess, the music was quite charming, a welcome relief after the road.

Before bed, I found Lilli and Klein at the inn. We had a pleasant chat over wine. I miss you and the boys terribly. Please do not worry about me; I am well. I look forward to our reunion.

Yours,
G.W.F.
